Here are some common HVAC problems that businesses in our area face:
Reduced Airflow: Clogged air filters or dirty condenser coils can restrict airflow. This makes your system work harder, leading to higher energy bills and potential breakdowns.
Uneven Temperatures: Problems like faulty thermostats or clogged drains can cause some areas to be too hot or too cold. This inconsistency can make it uncomfortable for employees and customers.
Strange Noises: Unusual sounds like clanging or rattling may signal loose parts or failing components. Ignoring these noises can lead to bigger issues later.

Short Cycling: If your AC turns on and off quickly, it could be due to a dirty filter or low refrigerant levels. This not only reduces efficiency but also shortens the lifespan of your equipment, costing you more in repairs.
